notes: Cloud session egress is restricted to git hosts only (confirmed: api.seranking.com, team.canadianwebdesigns.ca, and the live site all returned no route this session) — this matches runbook §0.5 exactly, so all keyword decisions used automation/keyword-data.json (offline SE Ranking snapshot, fetchedAt 2026-07-24) instead of live API calls, and this log's commit/push is the report delivery — the seo-report-relay.yml GitHub Action live-verifies the 8 shipped URLs with full egress and relays this report to the team portal + email. The blog theme substitution (GBP optimization → Google reviews) is a genuine one-pass topic-overlap catch, not a shortcut. Two real data-accuracy bugs were found and fixed on live pages (Brampton's stated keyword difficulty of 22 vs. the real 7, and Mississauga's unverifiable 5,000+ search volume claim) — worth spot-checking other already-shipped pages for similar drift in a future audit pass, though the one-pass rule means that can only happen via a read-only audit extra, never a re-edit of a done page.
